staticAnalysis: Private layout: template at private 0..17 (worker = 17 bytes 0..16, byte 17 = next arena byte: A zombie_entry 89h, B the arena byte after B's code, usually CCh). Rebuild: A4 movsb copies private[0] to P+1, A5 movsw copies private[1..2] to P+2..3, F3 A5 rep movsw with CX=9 copies private[3..20] to P+4..P+21 (B's first rebuild CX=8: private[3..18] to P+4..P+19). The worker executes P+1..P+17 (call far at P+16); P+18..P+21 receive private[17..20] (A: 89 00 00 00, B: CC 00 00 00) and are never executed. Cells at 2C0h/280h are far from the 0..20 read window; nothing else writes private memory (SS = arena after init). No harmful interaction; no fix needed. The overrun bytes are a free 4-byte write at old-anchor+18 each generation, used below to plant FF 1F CC CC decoys in every stale worker.

candidates.label: A022-SD (stale-decoy tails)
candidates.change: A and B: phoenix_init mov cx,9 -> mov cx,10 (template copy 10 words); db 0CCh,0CCh appended after the worker; the dead mov dx,[4A17h] (DX is zeroed by and dx,0) removed, so the turn count is unchanged. Template bytes 17/18 = CC CC, so every rebuild leaves FF 1F CC CC at old-anchor+16 (stale worker call far + overrun bytes) = decoy for INT87 FF1FCCCC searchers; A's code tail also reads FF 1F CC CC; B's natural tail decoy kept.

Screens x2hv2 vs ffhjf: changing these bytes (CC 90 vs CC CC) leaves every non-searcher cohort identical.

recommendation: promote-candidate to confirmation: SD (screen ALL +0.0104 [0.0026,0.0183], no negative group, threat +0.071 vs FF1FCCCC searchers) as the clean single mechanism; SDd (SD + dec0A, ALL +0.0168 [-0.0009,0.0345]) as the stronger searcher-defense package.
